name: Embed v4
description: Multimodal embedding model supporting text, images, and mixed inputs.
longDescription: Cohere Embed v4 is a state-of-the-art multimodal embedding model capable of embedding text, images, and mixed text+image inputs into the same vector space. It achieves best-in-class performance on multilingual retrieval benchmarks across 100+ languages.

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import cohere

co = cohere.ClientV2(api_key="YOUR_COHERE_API_KEY")
response = co.embed(
    model="embed-v4.0",
    input_type="search_document",
    texts=["Hello world"]
)
print(response.embeddings.float_[0][:5])
